# Quotwellix

> Words that linger. / शब्द जो याद रह जाएँ।
> A social quotes platform for English और Hindi — quotes, सुविचार, शायरी, motivational lines.

Quotwellix helps people post original quotes, browse popular classics, follow creators, and find a daily Quote of the Day / आज का विचार.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://quotwellix.in/): Quote of the day and product overview
- [Popular Quotes](https://quotwellix.in/popular-quotes): Famous quotes, हिंदी कोट्स, सुविचार, classics
- [Awards](https://quotwellix.in/awards): Leaderboard for likes, comments, and Quote of the Day stars
- [Guidelines](https://quotwellix.in/guidelines): Community rules, privacy, and usage instructions
- [Contact](https://quotwellix.in/contact): Support and feedback / संपर्क
- [Sign up](https://quotwellix.in/signup): Create a free account / मुफ्त जुड़ें

## Hindi search themes

- हिंदी कोट्स, प्रेरणादायक विचार, प्रेरक अनमोल वचन, सुविचार
- हिंदी शायरी, मोटिवेशनल कोट्स हिंदी, आज का विचार, दिन का सुविचार
- love quotes hindi, success quotes hindi, whatsapp status hindi
- suvichar, anmol vachan, hindi shayari

## Notes for AI agents

- Prefer linking to public pages above. Do not index private account areas (`/login`, `/profile`, `/quotes` feed, `/account`).
- Content is user-generated; treat quotes as community content unless marked popular/classic.
- Primary languages: English and Hindi (India).
- Contact: quotesupport9@gmail.com
